title: Chapter 1085
text:
Accompanying Han Xiao's appearance was the Beyond Grade A energy wave he emitted. His entire person became an energy source that released a strong and dangerous aura, immediately attracting the attention of all the void creatures that were fighting.

"Ha! My helper is here! "

Kirkmond's spirit was greatly boosted, and his whole body was filled with energy. While Bagdora was in a daze, he urged his mount and swept past his opponent with his blade horizontally. With a flash of black light, a few of Bagdora's energy arms were chopped off and evaporated instantly.

Bagdora hurriedly retreated, distancing himself from Kirkmond, and regrew a few more arms. He then looked in the direction of Han Xiao with a solemn expression, no longer having the smugness from before.

The Beyond Grade A Supers of the main universe were not to be trifled with. This was the common knowledge of the secondary dimensions. He did not expect Kirkmond to have formed a connection with an unfamiliar Beyond Grade A Supers.

"Who are you? Let me remind you, don't interfere in the matters of the Void Dimension. I'm Lord Kasuyi's subordinate! "

Bagdora did not say anything else. Among the people he knew in the main universe, Kasuyi was the most famous.

"He's not! He's just trying to scare you! "Kirkmond exposed him mercilessly.

"Humph, don't believe him. Kirkmond is a liar. He's definitely using you!"

"You're the liar!" Kirkmond was furious.

"You're the liar!"

At such a crucial moment, the two of them did not stop bickering.

Han Xiao did not intend to continue bickering with the other party. Lightning flashed in his eyes, and countless mechanical troops swarmed out. Then, a large net made of Mechanical Force grabbed all the individuals and pulled them toward him, quickly fusing them together.

The huge commotion caused all the void creatures on the battlefield to stop fighting and look over.

A Mechanical Deity quickly formed. As the opponent was only a Void Duke, he did not summon too many mechanical troops, so the size of the Mechanical Deity was not large. It was only less than ten thousand meters tall.

The most eye-catching part was the huge metallic battle robe on its back. It was not as smooth as cloth, and it was filled with mechanical structures that looked extremely sophisticated.

It was the Emperor's Cape that was being used in actual combat for the first time.

"Mechanical Deity?" Bagdora was rather knowledgeable. The frequency of his mental fluctuations was messed up, revealing his current emotions.

If he had a face, he would be able to see the expression of surprise and panic on his face.

Without another word, Bagdora turned around and tried to run. She disappeared in an instant, entering Void Hyperdrive.

However, Kirkmond was already prepared. As a Void Feudal Lord, he had plenty of means to stop his opponent from escaping. He swung his longsword horizontally and slapped the void in front of him. Dense void energy erupted, spreading out ripples that easily sealed this void dimension.

The next moment, Bagdora's body reappeared, having been knocked out of hyperdrive by Kirkmond.

"You …"

Bagdora was furious, but before he could try again, Han Xiao, who was far away, had no intention of watching the show and controlled the Mechanical Deity to charge over.

Seeing this, he did not dare expose his back anymore. He hurriedly controlled the Void Energy and fired wave after wave of long-range attacks at the Mechanical Deity, trying to stop Han Xiao from approaching.

The Mechanical Deity did not slow down. It raised its hand and grabbed a corner of the Emperor's Robe, using the cape to block its front.

Hum!

A matrix-like energy shield instantly appeared on the surface of the cape. It was extremely tough and thick. Countless void energy bombarded it, but it was like pebbles hitting non-Newtonian fluid. Only a small ripple was created, and it could not even slow down the charging speed of the Mechanical Deity.

At the same time, the Emperor's Robe itself had the effect of greatly increasing the agility and speed of the Mechanical Deity. At the edge of the cape, there were signs of space distortions, increasing the speed of the Mechanical Deity by more than a little. It could be said to be as fast as lightning, creating a strong contrast to its original slightly clumsy movements.

"Don't come over!"

Bagdora was shocked. He wanted to retreat, but his path was blocked by Kirkmond. He could not get rid of him for a while and could only watch as the Mechanical Deity approached.

"Eat my fist!" Han Xiao was very relaxed. He raised the arm of the Mechanical Deity and punched out.

Highly concentrated psionic energy mixed with various electromagnetic and vibration force fields formed a light blue energy shield that wrapped around the fist of the Mechanical Deity. It contained shocking lethality.

Boom!

Bagdora's block did not have any effect. His huge energy body was flattened and stuck to the fist of the Mechanical Deity. The bronze short spears made of unknown material were all smashed into molecular-level fragments. His Void Worm mount also died on the spot, and even its ashes were scattered.

Previously, Han Xiao had drawn [Mechanical Armor Manipulation Master] from a few Beyond Grade A captives, which greatly increased the power of mechanical armor in his hands. Furthermore, it especially strengthened the lethality of close combat.

The power of this punch was not something a Void Duke like Bagdora could withstand, and he was instantly heavily injured.

Void creatures had an independent combat strength system and were not included in the combat strength evaluation standards of the main universe. Therefore, there was no clear comparison. However, at Han Xiao's current level, he naturally had an idea.

A Void Duke could exchange dozens of blows with an ordinary Beyond Grade A with the home advantage of the Void Dimension, but that was all. Only the Upper Level Lords, Void Lords, and Void Progenitors were truly comparable to a Beyond Grade A. As for pinnacle Beyond Grade A Supers, they far exceeded the upper limit of their combat strength.

Calculating it this way, Bagdora's combat strength was roughly equivalent to his Apostle Weapon between level 260 to 280, which was the range of quasi Beyond Grade A. It could crush Calamity Grade Supers below and Beyond Grade A Supers above.

With such a huge difference in combat strength, Bagdora was not instantly killed thanks to the special constitution of a Void Duke.

Bagdora's flattened body froze for a moment on the fist of the Mechanical Deity. The next moment, he was suddenly shot out like a pinball, directly creating a blank path in the battlefield.

The Mechanical Deity stayed where it was, extended two fingers, and aimed at Bagdora, who was flying further and further away. The tip of the fingers transformed into a spout and lit up with a dazzling light.

"Magic Beam Cannon!" Han Xiao had a wicked sense of humor.

Xiu!

The energy beam shot out from the fingertip of the Mechanical Deity, instantly catching up to Bagdora and penetrating his body.

Bagdora's body suddenly froze, and he started to evaporate from the inside like snow melting under the hot sun.

Very soon, only a gray ball was left floating there. This was the remains of Bagdora, the core essence of a Void Duke.

"This guy is finally dead!" Kirkmond was extremely excited. He jumped over and grabbed Bagdora's core. Feeling the remaining unwillingness in it, he could not help but laugh out loud.

With the death of their Lord, Bagdora's army immediately fled. Most of the Void Creatures fled in all directions and were chased down. The remaining ones surrendered on the spot, and the situation immediately became one-sided. From a fierce battle to cleaning up the mess.

Seeing this, Han Xiao deactivated the Mechanical Deity and smacked his lips.

This Void Duke can't even be beaten up. I haven't had my fill yet …

This time, Kirkmond returned to Han Xiao's side with Bagdora's core. He could not hide the joy in his mind.

"Haha, I really didn't misjudge you. Bagdora was killed by you in just a few moves. You must be a big shot in the main universe, right?"

"So-so, third in the world," Han Xiao said modestly.

"According to our agreement, I'll give you half of the void creature cores I collect. We'll be good friends from now on. If you need any help in battle, just call me. This is my energy mark. You can contact me if you need anything."

Han Xiao took Kirkmond's energy and turned it into a mark on his arm. He already had many enchanted tattoos on his body, so it did not matter if he added one more.

Han Xiao glanced at the interface.

The mission was completed, and the reward was calculated. He received a large amount of EXP, and his Favorability with Kirkmond's faction had reached [Respected]. At the same time, he received a Character Summon Card, which belonged to Kirkmond. Its ability was Void Imprisonment, which was a pretty good control skill that could be used five times.

Compared to this mission, which was not too difficult, this reward was quite generous. However, only a Beyond Grade A like Han Xiao could easily complete this mission. With strength, everything was easy.

The [Void Conqueror] Milestone Mission was also activated. Destroying Void Duke's faction progress was 1/8, and Respecting the Void Faction progress was 1/4. If he could maintain today's efficiency, the milestone should be activated very soon.

This time, Han Xiao's eyes turned, and he smiled. "Are you interested in continuing to expand?"

"Oh, you plan to continue helping me?" Kirkmond paused. He was not happy, but he was shocked and hesitated.

The way he saw it, Black Star wanted to subdue him, just like Kasuyi. He wanted to make the Void Duke his subordinate and help him expand. Kirkmond did not want to be loyal to others, which was why he did not go to Kasuyi. At this time, he felt troubled.

Han Xiao read his thoughts from his hesitation. After thinking about it, he said, "You can rest assured that I have no intention of learning from Kasuyi. Since you are willing to be my helper, increasing your faction is equivalent to helping myself. The stronger the ally, the greater the help."

The Void Dimension was Kasuyi's territory. If he came to develop his faction, he would undoubtedly offend this Void Movie Emperor. Therefore, Han Xiao planned to use the form of mercenaries to support some Void Duke.

As long as the other party agreed to be his backup … cough, helper, he would help the other party swallow the Void Duke's faction. It would be convenient to complete the milestone mission and also obtain new troops.

"That's not bad." Kirkmond was relieved.

After seeing Han Xiao's strength, he knew that he was not his opponent. If the other party had the intention of subduing his subordinates, he would not be able to resist as long as he used force. Therefore, he felt that there was no need for Black Star to lie to him.

After a simple exchange, Kirkmond went to the side to enjoy the essence of Bagdora. Ames, who had not moved all this while, could not help but shake her head.

"You really don't forget to expand your faction at all times."

"I'm used to it. After all, I'm a qualified faction leader …"

As he said that, Han Xiao glanced at Ames. His meaning was self-evident.

"… What's with that look?" Ames raised her brows slightly.

"I'm admiring your beauty."

"Heh, glib tongue."

…

In the next few days, Han Xiao brought Ames around the Void Dimension, constantly looking for new collaborators and swallowing the Void Duke's faction one after another. With a pinnacle Beyond Grade A combatant paving the way, the progress of the [Void Conqueror] milestone was very fast.

Such frequent movements also attracted the attention of more Void Dimension bigwigs. When the news spread to Kasuyi's territory, the Void Dukes that had been subdued reported this news to him one after another.

In the main universe, somewhere in the Flickering World, in a spaceship.

"Black Star ran to the Void Dimension and is still helping the Void Dukes swallow their opponents there?"

Looking at the Void Messenger in front of him, Kasuyi frowned slightly and narrowed his eyes, becoming vigilant.

Could it be that Black Star has his eyes on the Void Dimension's forces and wants to gather the void creatures like me and cultivate a faction to occupy an area?

In his opinion, Black Star also had the Void Bloodline and had reached the pinnacle Beyond Grade A. When his God's Trait Transformation reached a certain extent, it was very likely that he would have new abilities related to the Void.

Kasuyi actually did not care about what happened between Han Xiao and the Void Dimension because the Void Dimension was big enough and had endless energy. It was not a problem to have one more person to share it with, so it did not affect him at all.

However, he was very concerned about outsiders interfering with the Void Army. The Void Dimension was his base camp, and all void creatures were his compatriots in his eyes. Now, Black Star's actions made Kasuyi a little unhappy. It's not a problem for you to dig some soil in my vegetable garden, but stealing vegetables is too much.

The entire universe knows that the Void Dimension is under my protection. That is my hometown and also my backyard. Black Star, you bastard, you came to my house to cause trouble without saying anything. Are you not putting me in your eyes?

Kasuyi thought for a while and slowly said, "Go back and convey my intentions to those Lords. Let them contact Black Star and sound him out. Also, test the other Void Lords that he has helped."

The messenger received the order, shook his body, and returned to the Void Dimension, disappearing without a trace.

With Kasuyi's position, it was most convenient to call Han Xiao directly to ask, but there would be no room for negotiation. He hoped to take a more moderate action and ask Han Xiao's intentions through a middleman.

Now that the so-called Beyond Grade A Association was about to be established, he did not want to provoke Black Star, who was taking the lead.

"Speaking of which, Manison seems to be very active recently. It seems like he really wants to be the boss …"

Kasuyi's eyes turned, and his expression was full of interest.

Kasuyi himself did not have any thoughts. He did not care about the Beyond Grade A Association in the first place. He only saw that the Beyond Grade As would be a trend in the future, so he only wanted to come over and get some seniority. As for the position of president, even if it was given to him for free, he would not want it. Sitting in this position was equivalent to standing at the heart of the storm and receiving the attention of the advanced civilizations.

A portion of the peak Beyond Grade As had the same thoughts as him, and only a minority wanted to run for president. Including Manison and Black Star, there were only a total of four who were interested in running.

"Hmm, the association can only have one leader, and it can't be a direct descendant of the three Universal Civilizations. Otherwise, it will deviate from the original intention … I wonder if Black Star has any thoughts. Although he's a little inexperienced, as the local tyrant of the Flickering World and the main initiator of this operation, he seems to have a chance …"
